Secret Place

precepts.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty: his protection. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence. That is the first plague, and the Lord will deliver us from it. In that one hour, when them bombs are falling, it is not going to come near us.
precepts.point: The key thing: the sore falls on the people that worship the image of the beast and have his mark. If it is only them, where are we? We are delivered.

note.label: The Plagues Coming to America

precepts.why:
The key thing in the verse is who the sore falls on: “upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.” If it is only them, where are we? What happened to us? We are delivered.

Psalms 91 explains why. “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” If you dwell in the secret place of the Most High, you dwell in his shadow, meaning his protection. “I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”

“Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.” That is the first plague, the noisome pestilence, and the Lord will deliver you from it. That is why the scripture says the plague fell only on those that worship the beast and have his mark: because we are delivered.

This plague is coming in that one hour, and in that one hour, when the bombs are falling, it is not going to come near us. The radioactive waves, the noisome pestilence, the poisoned water will not touch us, because the Lord is going to deliver us up out of here. The same pestilence that destroys America passes over the people who dwell under his shadow.

precepts.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. This is the place; this is where you find your rest and your protection.
precepts.point: We have to learn to come back to the Lord and walk in righteousness, because that man does not know peace; all he knows is war. Even though he loves saying the word peace, like his president: I will be known as the most peaceful president ever.

note.label: I Come In Peace

precepts.why:
God exalted Christ “to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.” Repentance is for Israel, the children of the captivity, of the slave trade, of the colonization of Africa, not the fake people in the land right now. The law was only given to us. Esau's only job is to whoop us into shape. We are in punishment right now; it is like we are in jail and they are the correction officers. We just have to do our time in peace and we are going to come out. But while we do our time, any time we move weirdly, they will break our back.

So when brothers say we should gather guns and go fight Esau: Negro, something is wrong with you. The Bible said the sword was his gift; the Lord gave him the sword. Read the name written on your gun: Smith & Wesson. We don't make guns; the AK-47 is the Russians, the Uzi is the Israelis. All they have to do is cut the water off in the hood. In Haiti a gang leader bought five of ten cases of bullets from a rich oligarch's man, and within the hour the police came, a three hour shootout used up all his bullets, and he had to call the same rich man for the rest. That is the setup: America will have a shootout with you, make you waste your bullets, and then you are dead. In 1985 they dropped a bomb on MOVE in Philly; at Waco, Esau came with tanks on white people, an offshoot of the Seventh-day Adventist Church, with kids inside. Stop playing.

Your only defense against this man is the Bible. “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” This is the place. This is where you find your rest and your protection.

We have to learn to come back to the Lord and walk in righteousness, because that man does not know peace. All he knows is war, even though he loves saying the word peace. The protection of Israel is not in the sword but in dwelling with the Most High, the same God who exalted Christ to give Israel repentance and forgiveness.

precepts.text: The secret place of the Most High is the Bible; the arrow that flieth by day is the missile and the destruction that wasteth at noonday; a thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand but it shall not come nigh thee, and his angels bear thee up: the deliverance of the Israelites in the midst of Armageddon, which Satan twisted to tell Christ to jump.
precepts.point: Many that sleep in the dust shall awake, some to everlasting life and some to shame. They that be wise, who study, pray and apply, shine as the firmament. The book was sealed to the time of the end, so the open understanding coming out now shows we are in it, and knowledge has increased.

note.label: From Exile & Tribulation to Promise

precepts.why:
Daniel says “there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered”. What makes this tribulation different is World War III and Armageddon, and Psalm 91 shows how Israel is delivered in the midst of it.

“He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” The secret place of the Most High is the Bible.

“Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day; Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” The arrow that flieth by day is the missile, the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

“A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee. Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.” And “he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.”

That is the deliverance of the Israelites in the midst of Armageddon: thy people delivered, every one found written in the book, not all nations. It is the same psalm Satan twisted when he told Christ to jump from the pinnacle of the temple.

precepts.text: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
precepts.point: Habakkuk 3:16, the prophet's belly trembled because he was put in it, and when he cometh up unto the people he will invade them with his troops. Isaiah 31:4, like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, the Lion of the tribe of Judah of Revelation 5:5, so shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion; as birds flying, Christ and the angels, he will defend Jerusalem, and passing over he will preserve it. Jeremiah 4:7, the lion is come up from his thicket, the destroyer of the Gentiles, Nebuchadnezzar contextually and Christ prophetically. 2 Esdras 11:37, a roaring lion chased out of the wood sends a man's voice unto the eagle, America.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
“For the eyes of the Lord are upon them that love him, he is their mighty protection and strong stay, a defence from heat, and a cover from the sun at noon”. God's eyes are on them that love him, and he is our mighty protection if we love him. A defence from what heat? Nuclear heat. And why a cover from the sun at noon? Because the destruction comes at noonday.

David shows it: “Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” The destruction wastes at noonday.

So all we have to do is be faithful and fear him, and he will protect us from the destruction to come. Sirach says the same of wisdom: “By her he shall be covered from heat, and in her glory shall he dwell.” By wisdom we shall be covered from the heat.

precepts.text: The secret things belong unto the Lord our God, but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
precepts.point: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder and trample the dragon, the nations. Because he hath set his love upon me, I will deliver him, set him on high, answer him, be with him in trouble, and with long life satisfy him and shew him my salvation.

note.label: Edom's Achilles' Heel

precepts.why:
“He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” The secret place of the Most High is the Bible. Moses says so: “The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.” God's word is his secrets, and what he has revealed of it belongs to Israel and our children forever, so that we may do his law.

So dwelling in the secret place means living in his word and keeping it. That is why “his truth shall be thy shield and buckler”: his law is thy shield and buckler. The one who dwells there can say “He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”

That is who the psalm protects when destruction comes. And it is coming, though some do not believe it because of God bless the USA, nothing could ever happen here. Job says “neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh”, because the Lord is telling us it is going to come. The arrow that flieth by day is the missile, and the destruction that wasteth at noonday tells you the time.

“A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee. Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.” The only reason we will see that and not be touched is “Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation”: because we dwell in the secret place, his word and his law.

precepts.text: They shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds with power and great glory, and he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet to gather his elect from the four winds.
precepts.point: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder and trample the dragon, the nations. Because he hath set his love upon me, I will deliver him, set him on high, answer him, be with him in trouble, and with long life satisfy him and shew him my salvation.

note.label: Edom's Achilles' Heel

precepts.why:
“For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.” What is that talking about? Matthew 24 shows it.

“And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory. And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” Those are the angels given charge over us.

There is going to be so much destruction that the angels will make sure we do not get hurt. We are going to be delivered while our enemies are being put to death. That is “Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.” The angels will protect the brothers and sisters alive at that time, so that, as Job says, “At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh.”

Then “Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet”: these are the nations, and we are going to trample them. Because the believer has set his love upon the Lord, he says “therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.” “I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him. With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.”

precepts.text: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
precepts.point: He shall deliver thee in six troubles; yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee. Psalm 91:7 says a thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. That fire is not coming near you.

note.label: There Is No Hate Like Christian Love

precepts.why:
We read the judgment: the sword coming for Esau and for the nations, for the Lord “will give them that are wicked to the sword”. “But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.” Israel is the poor, and you escape that judgment by keeping the commandments with faith in the Lord and Saviour Jesus the Christ. “So the poor hath hope”: hope that something better is coming than what we are in right now.

“He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.” David shows what that looks like: “A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.” That fire is not coming near you.

All that is read here is judgment: famine, war, the sword. “In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.” He is going to deliver you and redeem you from the power of that sword, even while thousands fall around you.

But it comes with correction: “happy is the man whom God correcteth”. Brothers get soft and mealy and yellow about correction, and sisters get bitter at those who correct them. Get rid of that soft spirit; man up and woman up. “he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.” He wounds you with the word and makes you whole again, so that no evil touches you when the judgment falls.

precepts.text: A thousand shall fall at thy side, but it shall not come nigh thee.
precepts.point: Israel must overcome its addictions and wait for that power, not act before its time.

note.label: Political Power Under Darkness

precepts.why:
He that overcomes and keeps Christ's works unto the end gets “power over the nations”, to “rule them with a rod of iron.” No weapon formed against us will prosper, and Psalm 91 goes with that: “Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day.”

The arrow that flieth by day is the missile. Read on: “Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday. A thousand shall fall at thy side.” What weapon do you think can do that? A gun cannot do that. That is nuclear destruction, and it is not going to touch you.

A thousand at thy side, “and ten thousand at thy right hand.” Think about it: you stand there, ten thousand people drop dead, and nothing can affect you. That is the type of power the Lord will give to him that overcometh.

That is why we must overcome and wait. I want that power to rule the nations, to break them just like they break us. But it is not talking about right now. We must have faith and wait for that spiritual power, and in that day nothing the nations send against us will come nigh us.

precepts.text: The same thought as Psalm 27: he that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High is under the shadow of the Almighty, his refuge and fortress.
precepts.point: Even with everything coming against us today, covid-19, the vaccine, all the different things being pushed, wars going on, these words remind us that in this we can be confident. Whether it is other camps, family, or other nations coming against us, we can still be confident.

note.label: Psalm 27: The Most High Is My Light and Salvation

precepts.why:
“Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.” Psalm 91 carries the same thought: “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”

He that dwells in the secret place of the Most High is under the shadow of the Almighty, his refuge and fortress. This is very good reading for what is going on in these last days. With everything coming against us today, covid-19, the vaccine, all the different things being pushed, wars going on, whether it is other camps, family, or other nations coming against us, in this we can still be confident. The wicked that come to eat up our flesh stumble and fall.

precepts.point: This is just one instance; there are many scenarios where the Most High will encamp around you and be your refuge, even when people come against IUIC He is there in the midst.

note.label: Psalm 27: The Most High Is My Light and Salvation

precepts.why:
“For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me”. Lord willing, much of Israel alive will have to go through this time of trouble, and He says He will hide you. Psalm 91 lays out that hiding: “Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence. He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.”

“Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day; Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday. A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.” A thousand fall at your side and ten thousand at your right hand, but it does not come near you.

“Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked. Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation”. Only with your eyes will you behold the reward of the wicked when Christ returns, because you made the Most High your habitation. This is just one instance; there are many scenarios where the Most High will encamp around you and be your refuge, even when people come against IUIC, He is there in the midst.

precepts.text: He that dwells in the secret place of the Most High abides under the shadow of the Almighty, and His truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
precepts.point: Where should we make our refuge? It begins with meditating on the scriptures, which is why the four chapters a day has been set up.

note.label: Psalm 57: My Heart Is Fixed

precepts.why:
“He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” That is the shadow of the wings David makes his refuge in. “I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.”

“He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.” Under his wings, covered with his feathers, and his truth is the shield and buckler. That is where the refuge is until these calamities be overpast, and it begins with meditating on the scriptures, the truth that shields.

precepts.text: God's laws are the truth; His righteousness is an everlasting righteousness.
precepts.point: His truth shall be our shield and buckler. The shield is what you use to protect yourself, so we have to understand what the truth is.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

precepts.why:
“He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.” The shield is what you use to protect yourself, so we have to understand what the truth is. Psalm 119 tells us: “Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.”

God's laws are the truth, and his righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. So the shield and buckler that covers whoever dwells in the secret place of the Most High is his law.

When we say the Most High is our refuge and fortress and put our trust in him, he delivers us from the snare of the fowler and the noisome pestilence, and the law is what we hold up as our shield.

precepts.text: Take heed no man deceive you; wars and rumors of wars must come, but see that ye be not troubled as long as your trust is in our God.
precepts.point: Christ warned us about this. A thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. That means we have to gird up our minds, because we are going to see death, more than the little jimmy or pookie getting shot in the streets that we have been seeing.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day”. The Most High is preparing us that a time of destruction is coming upon the earth, and we are not supposed to fear that time because our trust is in our God. Christ warned us about this: “Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many. And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.”

Take heed no man deceive you. Wars and rumours of wars must come, but see that ye be not troubled, as long as your trust is in our God. That is Psalm 91: the terror and the arrow and the pestilence are coming, and we are not to be afraid of them.

“A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.” We have to gird up our minds, because we are going to see death, more than the little jimmy or pookie getting shot in the streets that we have been seeing.

precepts.text: They shall deliver you up to be afflicted and killed, and ye shall be hated of all nations for Christ's name's sake.
precepts.point: Christ warned us about this. A thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. That means we have to gird up our minds, because we are going to see death, more than the little jimmy or pookie getting shot in the streets that we have been seeing.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

precepts.why:
Christ goes on to say what the time of destruction looks like for us: “Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake. And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another. And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.”

They shall deliver you up to be afflicted and killed, and ye shall be hated of all nations for Christ's name's sake. This is the terror by night and the destruction that wasteth at noonday. Christ told us it was coming so we would not fear it.

A thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand. We are going to see death, so we gird up our minds, trusting the Most High that it shall not come nigh us.

precepts.text: Because iniquity, being sin, shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
precepts.point: Christ warned us about this. A thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. That means we have to gird up our minds, because we are going to see death, more than the little jimmy or pookie getting shot in the streets that we have been seeing.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

precepts.why:
“And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.” Iniquity is sin. Because sin shall abound in the time of destruction, the love of many shall wax cold; they shall betray one another and hate one another.

That is part of the pestilence that walketh in darkness in Psalm 91. It is not only the thousand that fall at thy side; it is the love of many going cold around you. We are not to fear it, because our trust is in our God, and we gird up our minds for it.

precepts.text: He that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved; this is the point for us.
precepts.point: Christ warned us about this. A thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. That means we have to gird up our minds, because we are going to see death, more than the little jimmy or pookie getting shot in the streets that we have been seeing.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

precepts.why:
“But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.” This is the point for us. Through the terror by night, the arrow by day, the pestilence and the destruction at noonday, through the wars, the affliction, the hatred of all nations and the love of many waxing cold, he that endures unto the end shall be saved.

That is why Psalm 91 says “it shall not come nigh thee.” A thousand fall at your side and ten thousand at your right hand, but the one who keeps his trust in the Most High and endures is the one who comes through. Gird up your mind and endure to the end.

precepts.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High, which is the Bible, shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty, which is the protection.
precepts.point: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from Thy statutes, for their deceit is falsehood. Those that err from this Bible, their deceit is falsehood, which is why we have to hate every false way. My flesh trembleth for fear of Thee, and I am afraid of Thy judgments.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

precepts.why:
“Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.” The hiding place is protection. “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.”

The secret place of the Most High is the Bible. He that dwells in it abides under the shadow of the Almighty, which is the protection: hold thou me up, and I shall be safe.

precepts.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High, which is the Bible, shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty, the protection we get.
precepts.point: The Most High shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

note.label: Psalm 121: My Help Cometh From the Lord

precepts.why:
“He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” The secret place of the Most High is the Bible, and the shadow of the Almighty is the protection we get. That is the same shade in “The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.”

He is our keeper and our protector, and the shade is the protection he gives, so that the sun shall not smite by day nor the moon by night.

precepts.text: The passage the devil quoted: he shall give his angels charge over thee.
precepts.point: This is why brothers and sisters must be able to try what is brought to them. Men can come with fringes and strong classes and still be workers of deceit.

note.label: Matthew 4: The Temptation in the Wilderness and the Calling of the Fishers

precepts.why:
The devil set Christ on a pinnacle of the temple and quoted scripture at him: “for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.” This is the passage he quoted: “For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.”

Satan knows the scriptures and will use them. He took a true promise of the Most High and turned it into a dare, “cast thyself down”. That is why brothers and sisters must be able to try what is brought to them. A scripture in a man's mouth does not make him of God.

Psalms 91:5-6 proves it is talking about being away from these weapons.

You have to be in the shadow; God is going to protect you. And you women talking all that filth about your husbands: you are going to have to cover your head that day.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 11 A Time Of Defamation

precepts.why: Can you imagine this thing we see? So it is not paraphrased: “Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;” The arrow that flies by day is the ICBM missile that is going to be shot here in America. “Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” God is telling you this final destruction is going to happen at noonday. “A thousand shall fall at thy side,” We are going to see a thousand people getting put to death on our side, “and ten thousand at thy right hand;” On our right hand we are going to see ten thousand people being incinerated. “but it shall not come nigh thee.” Why? Because them angels are going to protect us; that is why we went to Matthew 24:31. “Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.”

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 4 Kingdom Vision

precepts.why: “Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.”. The Lord reveals his secret to his servants the prophets. Those secrets are in the scriptures, explaining why dwelling in the secret place means dwelling in the Bible rather than living in fear of every new disease.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 4 Kingdom Vision

precepts.why: The secret things belong to the Lord, but the revealed things belong to us and our children for ever, so that we may do all the words of this law. The secrets are bound to the law in the Bible. God's protection is connected to receiving and doing what he has revealed, not ignoring it while panicking over the world.

moments.label: The Image of Dysfunction or the Image of God Which One Are You?
The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: The opening prayer: he that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night nor the arrow that flieth by day; a thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee; only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

note.label: The Image of Dysfunction or the Image of God Which One Are You?

points: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High. The secret place of the Most High is the Bible. His laws.
Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. Meaning protection. His shadow means his protection.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day. The arrow is the weapon. That is the nuclear weapon. That is the waster. That is the arrow that flieth by day.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday. This is the waster. That is what we just read in Isaiah 54:16.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: A thousand shall fall at thy side. Because when that waster, that weapon, hits land, it says a thousand shall fall at thy side.

And ten thousand at thy right hand. You are going to see ten thousand people drop dead, get incinerated, at our right hand. But it shall not come nigh thee. But those brothers and sisters who are alive at that time, it says it shall not come near thee.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. The secret place is the scriptures and prayer; that is our protection.

note.label: The Storm Before the Kingdom

points: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night nor the arrow that flieth by day. Read it as if you lived in Iran, in Israel, in Gaza: the arrows are missiles and you do not know when one hits your house, your car, or the building you work in, or misses the house next door and hits yours. A hundred and sixty girls were dressed and sent to school one morning; their teacher did not know she was not coming back.

note.label: The Storm Before the Kingdom

points: Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday. You have taken lunch at noon at the same job for twenty years; out of nowhere, boom. It is not if, it is when. Take the mindset that it can never happen here out of your head. America is 250 years old and no country has ever fought a war on her soil, which is why you are so comfortable.

note.label: The Storm Before the Kingdom

points: Because thou hast made the Lord thy habitation, there shall no evil befall thee.

note.label: The Storm Before the Kingdom

points: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. The secret place is the Bible; Deuteronomy 29:29 says the things revealed belong to us and our children that we may do all the words of this law. His truth, his law, is thy shield and buckler.

note.label: Edom's Achilles' Heel

points: Thou shalt not be afraid for the arrow that flieth by day, the missile, nor the destruction that wasteth at noonday, which tells you the hour. A thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee; only with thine eyes shalt thou behold the reward of the wicked, because thou hast made the Lord thy refuge.

note.label: Edom's Achilles' Heel

points: He shall give his angels charge over thee, to bear thee up lest thou dash thy foot against a stone. Matthew 24:31 shows the angels gathering the elect with a great sound of a trumpet; there will be so much destruction that the angels keep us from being hurt while our enemies are put to death.

note.label: Edom's Achilles' Heel

points: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder and trample the dragon, the nations. Because he hath set his love upon me, I will deliver him, set him on high, answer him, be with him in trouble, and with long life satisfy him and shew him my salvation.

note.label: Edom's Achilles' Heel

points: Whoever dwells in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under His shadow. When we say the Most High is our refuge and fortress and put our trust in Him, He delivers us from the snare of the fowler and the noisome pestilence.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

points: His truth shall be our shield and buckler. The shield is what you use to protect yourself, so we have to understand what the truth is.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

points: We are not to be afraid of the terror by night nor the arrow that flieth by day. The Most High is preparing us that a time of destruction is coming upon the earth, and we are not supposed to fear that time because our trust is in our God.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

points: Christ warned us about this. A thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. That means we have to gird up our minds, because we are going to see death, more than the little jimmy or pookie getting shot in the streets that we have been seeing.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

points: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked. Because we have made the Most High our habitation, no evil shall befall us and no plague shall come nigh our dwelling.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

points: This does not mean some of us will not die, but the Most High promises He will protect us. We have to make sure we are grounded in this truth.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

points: He shall give His angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. Because he hath set his love upon the Most High and known His name, the Most High will deliver him and set him on high.
His name being the commandments, the laws. The Most High promises to answer him, be with him in trouble, deliver and honor him, and satisfy him with long life.

note.label: Psalm 91: Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High

points: The secret place of the Most High is the Bible. Dwelling there means abiding under the Almighty's shadow, his protection, where the heat cannot burn you. The Lord is our refuge and fortress; put your trust in him.

The sisters panicking on Facebook over the coronavirus need to examine that trust. AIDS, Ebola, Zika, SARS, swine flu, bird flu and mad cow disease have already come and gone as the thing everybody fears. The sisters slandering, gossiping and carrying evil spirits are nervous because they know they are not right. Stay in God's secret place instead of spreading panic or running after every warning.

Do not shave your beard because somebody claims it will give you coronavirus or stop you getting a job. People without beards are catching it. Do not let that claim make you forsake the commandments. The fear about going to Chinese nail and hair shops is another reason to stop depending on those people.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 4 Kingdom Vision

points: A fowler catches birds with traps. God delivers his people from the snares Esau lays and from the noisome pestilence, meaning disease. He covers them with his feathers, and they trust under his wings. His truth is his law, their shield and buckler. A shield is the larger protection against a sword and a buckler the smaller shield. The law is the protection to rely on, not panic buying every bottle of Lysol because the label mentions coronavirus.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 4 Kingdom Vision

points: Do not fear the terror by night, the arrow by day or the pestilence walking in darkness. The arrow is nuclear weapons and the pestilence includes coronavirus, Ebola and Zika. Do not go around terrified, assuming a baby's cold is coronavirus or coming to school wearing a mask out of fear. Pray to the Lord and keep faith.

“nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” There is a mystery in that timing: the destruction happens at noon. The fourth seal reveals the conquering race bringing death, hell, pestilence and disease, but God's people are to dwell in his protection.
